{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend blazer, structured single-breasted cut with notch lapels, length ending at the hip, color #36454F.
Ivory silk-cambric blouse, classic pointed collar and French cuffs, cropped slightly above the waistline, color #FFFFF0.
High-waisted pleated midi skirt in matte fabric, A-line silhouette falling to mid-calf, color #2C2C2C.
Pointed-toe leather pumps with a moderate heel, sleek silhouette, color #1A1A1A.
Matte black clutch bag, rectangular structured shape, color #000000.
Thin silver chain necklace and simple stud earrings to complete the look, metallic finish, color #E8E8E8.
This outfit embodies a restrained and classic aesthetic perfectly suited for an evening at a rock concert where standing in a crowd is anticipated. The structured blazer and pleated skirt provide a timeless silhouette that balances the energetic atmosphere with a touch of sophisticated elegance. By sticking to a monochromatic palette of charcoal, ivory, and black, the ensemble maintains the requested understated vibe while ensuring visibility and comfort through movement-friendly cuts like the pleats."}
